title: Mel's Writeup for the Blackjack Program
summary: How to set the tab stops, load the tape and place a bet — written for whoever sat at the machine.
description: The original program writeup by Mel Kaye for the Blackjack game on the RPC-4000 — the very program described in The Story of Mel. Written for the person sitting at the machine: how to set the typewriter tab stops, load the tape, place a bet. Mel's Loop holds a full transcription.
